title: Freezer Fan Fault
shortDescription: The evaporator fan is not running at the correct speed.
fullDescription:
FF indicates that the evaporator (freezer) fan has failed to reach commanded RPM. The control disables cooling to prevent uneven temperatures.

Ice buildup or a failed fan motor are the usual causes. Defrost the freezer and inspect the fan before replacing the motor.

fixSteps.title: Defrost
fixSteps.instruction: Unplug and allow a full manual defrost.

fixSteps.title: Replace fan
fixSteps.instruction: Install new evaporator fan motor if it will not spin freely.

whenToCallPro: Call a pro if defrost and motor replacement do not restore the fan.

title: System Communication Error
shortDescription: The main board has lost communication with a subsystem.
fullDescription:
SY indicates an internal communication fault between the main control and a peripheral board (UI, inverter, ice maker).

Power cycle the freezer. Persistent SY means a board replacement is likely required.
whenToCallPro: Call a pro if reseating does not clear SY.

faq.a: Sometimes yes in a default mode, but settings may be locked.

title: Open Thermistor
shortDescription: A temperature sensor shows an open circuit.
fullDescription:
OP means the freezer or evaporator thermistor is reading open. The control falls back to a fixed compressor run pattern.

Replace the sensor after a resistance check.
whenToCallPro: Call a pro if code persists after sensor swap.

faq.a: Usually yes, but temperature can swing.

title: Closed (Shorted) Thermistor
shortDescription: A temperature sensor shows a short circuit.
fullDescription: CL is the shorted counterpart to OP. Replace the sensor and verify the harness is not pinched.

fixSteps.title: Inspect harness
fixSteps.instruction: Look for pinch points along the sensor lead.

whenToCallPro: Call a pro if code persists after sensor swap.

faq.a: Short term — extended running shortens compressor life.

title: Defrost Heater Fault
shortDescription: The defrost heater is not drawing current.
fullDescription:
HD indicates the control energized the defrost heater but saw no current draw. A broken heater element or blown thermal fuse is typical.

Expect heavy frost on the evaporator.

fixSteps.title: Test heater
fixSteps.instruction: Measure continuity across the heater and thermal fuse.

whenToCallPro: Call a pro if coils refreeze quickly after the repair.
videoSearchQuery: GE freezer HD defrost heater fix

faq.a: Most models run a cycle every 8-12 compressor hours.

title: Ice Maker Sensor Error
shortDescription: The ice maker thermistor is out of range.
fullDescription:
IS is flagged when the ice maker sensor does not track normal cooling. The ice maker disables itself to avoid jammed cycles.

Replace the ice maker sensor or the entire ice maker module if repair parts are unavailable.

fixSteps.title: Replace sensor
fixSteps.instruction: Install new ice maker thermistor per service manual.

whenToCallPro: Call a pro if the ice maker module must be swapped.
videoSearchQuery: GE freezer IS ice maker sensor fix

faq.a: Yes — only the ice maker is disabled.

title: Compressor / Inverter Fault
shortDescription: The compressor inverter reported a fault.
fullDescription:
CE on inverter-driven GE freezers indicates the linear or variable-speed compressor driver has detected an internal error — overcurrent, overtemp, or lost rotor-lock.

Power cycle. Persistent CE requires inverter board or compressor service.
whenToCallPro: Call a pro if the compressor itself is suspected.

faq.a: It stops cooling, so move food to a backup freezer.

title: Door Ajar Alarm
shortDescription: The door has been open too long.
fullDescription:
dE indicates the freezer door has been open for more than about 5 minutes. Ensure the door seals fully.

If it appears with the door closed, replace the door switch.

fixSteps.title: Replace switch
fixSteps.instruction: Install new door switch if needed.

whenToCallPro: Call a pro only if switch swap does not resolve.
videoSearchQuery: GE freezer dE door alarm fix

title: Alarm High Temperature
shortDescription: Freezer temperature is above safe threshold.
fullDescription:
AH warns that the freezer has risen above roughly 15 F. Causes include long open-door events, warm-food loading, or a cooling issue.

Inspect the door seal and check that the fan and compressor run normally.
whenToCallPro: Call a pro if AH returns with a verified closed door.
videoSearchQuery: GE freezer AH high temperature fix

faq.a: Only if it is still firm with ice crystals present.

title: Filter Reminder
fullDescription:
Fi is a reminder, not a fault. It indicates the freezer's filter has reached the recommended replacement interval.

Replace the filter and reset the reminder per the user manual.

fixSteps.title: Replace filter
fixSteps.instruction: Swap the air or water filter.

fixSteps.title: Reset reminder
fixSteps.instruction: Hold the filter-reset button for 3 seconds.

faq.q: How often should I replace the filter?
faq.a: Every 6 months for most GE freezers.
